_comment: Copy as config.json (or point elsewhere with the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable). This file carries database and skill_dir; LLM and other settings are configured in the app (System > LLM), not here.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: ARTEX_PG_DSN env var > database in this file. Pick one: (A) component fields below, or (B) database.dsn as a full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): use a full DSN instead (when dsn is non-empty, component fields are ignored).
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root (one subdir per skill with SKILL.md). Precedence: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty/delete to use the default.
